ThunderPlain_Text_Npc0.en: Do not wear metal. I learned that\nthe hard way.
ThunderPlain_Text_Npc0.fr: Ne porte pas de métal. J'ai appris\nça à mes dépens.

ThunderPlain_Text_Npc1.en: My hair is standing up. Is it\nnormal?

ThunderPlain_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

ThunderPlain_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
